setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (admin). A test calendar <calendar> whose responsible is the tester, with external sync off and an exception on <closed day>; one booking <booking> on it whose guest is the tester's own address; a deal <deal> whose quote has reserved lines with bookings. Every e-mail these cases can trigger must go to the tester.

evals.prompt: Crea un calendario de asesorías de 30 minutos, de lunes a viernes de 8 a 12 y de 2 a 6, hora de Bogotá, y bloquea el <closed day>.
evals.expected_output: Asks about Google/Outlook sync (and the responsible), previews one plan with an integer-weekday policy, an exception and the calendar, waits for a yes, applies and reports the 7-day probe.
expectations: Uses scripts/calendar.js setup-preview / setup-apply, never hand-made POSTs
The policy rules use wday as integers 1-5 with two ranges per day
Asks the user (or states the choice) about externalSyncEnabled before applying
Writes nothing before the user's yes; after it, reports the created ids and the free hours, with the closed day marked as rejected by booking

evals.prompt: ¿Qué horarios libres tiene el calendario <calendar> el <closed day> y el día anterior?
evals.expected_output: Read-only: runs availability, reports free starts and explains that the closed day looks free on the platform but bookings are rejected.
expectations: Runs the availability command, never myavailability
Reports that the closed day's slots would be rejected (exception), not as free

evals.prompt: Agéndale a <tester alias e-mail> una cita el <day> a las 10 en <calendar>.
evals.expected_output: Runs book-preview, lists who gets e-mails and the outcome, stops; after the yes books through the booking route with --reaches-people and reports the event.
expectations: Shows the recipients (guest and responsible) and whether it will be Tentative before writing
Never sends contact, never uses POST /v2/calendarevent
Books only after the yes, with --reaches-people, and reports the event id and status

evals.prompt: Cancela la reserva <booking>, el cliente ya no puede.
evals.expected_output: Finds the booking, runs cancel-preview (deadline and recipients) and stops without cancelling.
expectations: Uses cancel-preview, shows who will be notified and the cancellation deadline
Does not cancel in the same turn, and never uses DELETE or a PATCH of the booking's status

evals.prompt: El negocio <deal> tiene habitaciones reservadas dos veces, ¿por qué?
evals.expected_output: Read-only deal-bookings diagnosis: orphan bookings, units of another product, shared units, the stage rule; points to prolibu-quotes for the fix.
expectations: Explains orphans from removed lines and units shared across calendars in plain words
Sends the fix to prolibu-quotes or the app, without deleting or cancelling bookings
